chapterFiles.title: Acts 2 — Pentecost: the tongues of fire descending + Peter's sermon citing Joel 2 the cosmic-signs
Acts 12 — Peter's prison release via angelic intervention
Acts 15 — The Jerusalem Council: the Gentile-inclusion decision
Acts 17 — Paul at the Areopagus / Mars Hill: the unknown-god speech + the Aratus quote

versionSource: Best-effort reconstruction from earliest-attested Koine Greek uncial codices: Codex Vaticanus (B/03) + Codex Sinaiticus (א/01) + early papyri cross-collation + NA28/UBS5/SBLGNT critical apparatus
sourceCitation: Codex Vaticanus (B/03; Vatican Library Gr. 1209, 4th c. CE) + Codex Sinaiticus (א/01; British Library Add. 43725 et al., 4th c. CE) as primary uncial witnesses. Cross-collation against P45 (Chester Beatty I, ~250 CE) for Mark/Acts; P75 (Bodmer XIV-XV, ~175-225 CE) for Luke; P47 (Chester Beatty III, ~250 CE) for Revelation. Critical apparatus: NA28 (Nestle-Aland 28th, 2012); UBS5 (United Bible Societies 5th, 2014); SBLGNT (SBL 2010); THGNT (Tyndale House 2017). Commentary references vary by book — see per-book documentation.

subtitles.en: Four canon-cited Acts chapters: Acts 2 (Pentecost), 12 (Peter's prison release), 15 (Jerusalem Council), 17 (Areopagus)

descriptions.en: Four canon-cited Acts chapters from the earliest substantial Koine Greek manuscript witnesses (Codex Vaticanus + Codex Sinaiticus + P45 Chester Beatty I ~250 CE for Acts; + NA28/UBS5/SBLGNT critical apparatus). Acts 2 (Pentecost), 12 (Peter prison release), 15 (Jerusalem Council Gentile-inclusion), 17 (Paul at the Areopagus + the Aratus citation). The Raëlian canon engages each of these chapters in *Extraterrestrials Took Me To Their Planet* — acknowledgment-without-endorsement framework applied at each canon-citation site per the established convention.
